persona.how_it_works: "Two axes, one struct. persona = role-blend x journey-stage (Canon Part 2a). The 7 personas are NOT an enum the user picks; they are 7 weighted FLOAT axes (0.0-1.0) in role_blend, defined once in persona-taxonomy.cjs and frozen. REPRESENTATION: display form ('Founder','Domain Expert') in ROLE_BLEND_AXES; store/disk form (lowercase snake_case 'founder','domain_expert') in ROLE_BLEND_KEYS. SET (3 ways): (1) inferred -- shallow-doc-parser.parseRoleHints regex-detects a canonical_role from CV/paste (only 4 of 7 detectable), blendFromCanonicalRole turns it into a single-axis {key:1.0}, room-birth writes it to USER.md; (2) conversational -- onboard.md/new-project.md have Larry infer canonical_role + override role_blend axes from dialogue signals, then writeUserMdAtomic; (3) navigator override -- persona-override.cjs CLI/store declares a synthetic persona in ~/.mindrian/persona-override.json that masks USER.md and survives maintenance commands. STORED in per-room USER.md frontmatter (canonical_role + role_blend{7 axes} + journey_stage + larry_persona + brain_persona + problem_type + venture_stage). CONSUMED: readUserMd() is the one chokepoint every reader uses; it returns the struct (or override). The first-touch greeting selects an agents/larry-extended.md persona_variants string keyed by canonical_role (prose-level, no code selector). detectPersonaUpdate gates re-detection (0.75 confidence + 3 consecutive signals before overwriting). Larry-side TTO/Researcher/Business maps many-to-one to Brain Explicit/Implicit so only a generic scalar (never role_blend weights or user_id) can cross the Part 8 boundary."

hypothesis.how_it_works:
"State of Phase 174 = SEEDED + RESEARCHED, NOT specced and NOT built. The only artifacts are the ROADMAP stub (.planning/ROADMAP.md:3013-3032) and one research file (174-RESEARCH.md). No SPEC.md, no CONTEXT.md, no plans, no code, no test, no canon amendment, no blueprint-family entry. The roadmap itself says 'Not yet specced. Next when promoted: /gsd-spec-phase 174.'

What the seed/research ENVISIONED: a hypothesis-first arrival as a THIRD door alongside the existing arrival_asset doors -- explicitly a PEER arrival mode, not a replacement (174-RESEARCH.md section C: 'Phase 174 adds the hypothesis door; it does NOT replace the others. Ignite's B1 starting-point gate should treat hypothesis as a peer arrival mode'). Today B1 (commands/ignite.md:82-90) routes role-blend -> one of 8 blueprintFamily values (venture/exploration/solution-first/etc.); the brief's Section-2 gate asks 'What are you arriving WITH?' with solution/domain/venture options. The seed wants to add a 'start from a hypothesis' branch: capture one falsifiable 'I believe ___' statement, file it as the room's seed assumption (truth-claim node, review_status:proposed, Part 5 tier None/Practitioner), derive a problem-definition draft, and feed Engine 1 from that sharper seed.

The research goes well beyond a literal 'I believe' capture. It envisions: (a) a META-HYPOTHESIS reframe ('the real bottleneck is X, reachable by Y not Z'); (b) the AION four-beat pipeline (import adjacent-domain reasoning layers -> 2x2 novelty-x-defensibility filter -> adversarial validate expecting most to die -> extrapolate the survivor); (c) a five-element defensible-hypothesis rubric (causal chain / provenance / parsimony / alternatives / quantitative plausibility); (d) an abstraction-level control gate (the key design constraint: let the domain expert set/correct whether the hypothesis is about instances vs structures); (e) 'end on a path forward / better questions, not a verdict'; and (f) a richer PERSON-ANCHORED arrival capturing (person CV/IKA + hypothesis + motivation) then running domain/sub-domain extraction (Engine 1) as the FIRST move.

The design philosophy is explicitly Reuse-Before-Build (Canon Part 7): the net-new is only the hypothesis ARRIVAL classification + the abstraction-level control + the 'end on a path forward' contract; everything downstream (research, whitespace, reverse-salient, claims/evidence, opportunity ranking) is repointed, not rebuilt."

birth.how_it_works: "The birth flow is a three-gate chain on the shared runChain spine. B1 (pre-room, F.1) establishes WHO is arriving: ignite's persona-first B1 sets role_blend from the picked persona and DERIVES blueprintFamily from it (Researcher/Student/Domain-expert -> exploration; Founder/Operator/Investor -> venture); a 'Paste my CV' pick (arrival_asset='cv-upload') triggers detect_dual_path -> extract_shallow which pulls canonical_role (-> role_blend), venture (-> blueprintFamily), and domains, then reflects it back. The B1 answer is journaled to scratchpad.birth_gate_answers via writeScratchpadBirthAnswer. B2 (pre-room, F.0) is the blueprint approve gate delegated to new-project: it displays Name/Slug/Section-set(from blueprintFamily)/Stage/JTBD/Persona plus the mandatory nugget routing table, then Approve/Reject(Adjust)/Defer. APPROVE is the Canon Part 9 promotion moment: it calls birthRoom({...opts, approvedBy: resolveByUser(roomDir)}). birthRoom runs 7 steps: STEP 1 scaffold (mkdir + .room-root sentinel + scaffoldRoomSkeleton(blueprintFamily) + per-section feynman seeds + writeUserMdAtomic(USER.md with canonical_role+role_blend+journey_stage) -- THIS is where role_blend lands at birth); STEP 2 the SQLite ACID block (writeClaimNode venture node -> setFocus -> drainBirthGateAnswers replaying scratchpad gate answers as typed cascade edges -> confirmNode batch byUser from USER.md -> jtbd_transitioned + room_created memory_events -> COMMIT); STEP 3 compute-state; STEP 4 registry create (commit point, flips active pointer LAST); STEP 5 reconcileMemoryArtifacts; STEP 6 scratchpad migrateToRoom; STEP 7 BRAIN-derivation enqueue log. The birthRoom ordering guard is load-bearing: B3 fires ONLY after birthRoom returns ok:true. B3 (in-room, F.1, full ranker) is the first-win Decision Gate that renders the per-persona first-framework chain and the domain-insight sweep reward, recording the pick via closeReach/recordSelectorDecision (SELECTED_REACH edge)."

(4) data/room-blueprints.json + resolveBlueprint are the persona-conditional scaffold engine -- reuse; extend default_methodologies consumption rather than re-deriving sections. (5) writeScratchpadBirthAnswer/drainBirthGateAnswers journal-and-replay is the cross-session bus -- reuse. BUILD NEW (minimal, Canon Part 7 justified): (a) THE CV-SECOND-SELECT: a real domain multiSelect gate (Shape F via pickShape with payload.verbs + multiSelect) that consumes extractDomains() output and writes the navigator's 2-3 picks -- this is the named deferred item and has no code today. (b) THE PER-PERSONA JTBD/FIRST-WIN: a resolver that maps role_blend x blueprintFamily to a first-framework chain (route through the Phase 122 command-resolver / Phase 166 runChain, NOT a new selection brain per Canon Part 11 R4) and populates ROOM.md default_methodologies FROM the chosen chain. (c) WIDEN writeScratchpadBirthAnswer to persist role_blend + blueprint_family (currently dropped) so the B1 persona signal survives to birthRoom across sessions. (d) A weighted-blend computer (extend blendFromCanonicalRole beyond single-axis) + journey_stage inference from the CV. (e) RECONCILE the two B1 specs into one persona-first B1. CONTRACT THE REDESIGN MUST HONOR: role_blend is written exactly once at birth via writeUserMdAtomic inside birthRoom STEP 1 (before confirmNode); birthRoom stays the only promotion path and stays approvedBy-gated; B3 fires only after birthRoom ok:true; every gate answer journals via writeScratchpadBirthAnswer and replays via drainBirthGateAnswers as typed edges (no CHOSE); blueprintFamily must resolve to a known family in room-blueprints.json or fall back to frozen SECTION_NAMES; all CV/domain handles stay Part-8 clean (auditQueryString); no new reach/edge type minted (Canon Part 11)."

syn.persona_set_verdict: ALREADY EXISTS as a full, canon-locked system - do NOT rebuild it. The 7 personas (researcher/student/founder-business/operator/investor/domain-expert, the 7th being mentor) are a FROZEN vocabulary defined once in lib/core/persona-taxonomy.cjs:114-122 (ROLE_BLEND_AXES, display form) and lib/core/persona-override.cjs:80-94 (ROLE_BLEND_KEYS, lowercase snake_case store keys, with normalizeRoleKey coercion). They are NOT an enum the user picks - they are 7 weighted float axes (0.0-1.0) in role_blend (Canon Part 2a: persona = role-blend x journey-stage). The persistence engine is lib/core/user-md-ops.cjs (emptyUser:76-106 defines all 7 axes; readUserMd:222-358 is the single read chokepoint ~9 callers funnel through; writeUserMdAtomic:440-501 atomic tmp+rename; detectPersonaUpdate:528-554 gates re-detection at 0.75 confidence + 3-consecutive-signal). The override store (persona-override.cjs, ~/.mindrian/persona-override.json) survives auto-detect AND /mos:doctor and masks USER.md for every reader. Three set-paths already exist: (1) inferred from CV (parseRoleHints + blendFromCanonicalRole + room-birth write), (2) conversational (onboard.md:413-431 / new-project.md), (3) navigator override (persona-override CLI). IMPORTANT: the SAME 7 names also exist as a SEPARATE team-member archetype system (Canon Part 2 / Appendix E; lib/core/navigation/synthetic-expert.cjs; agents/persona-analyst.md De Bono hats) - do NOT conflate the navigator's role_blend (USER.md, 7 weighted axes) with the team-member archetype tag (SyntheticExpert nodes). B1 operates on role_blend, not the hats system. Gaps that bound a B1 redesign: (a) blend is single-axis only today (blendFromCanonicalRole -> {key:1.0}; no real weighted tuple is ever computed by any producer); (b) only 4 of 7 axes are CV-inferable (Mentor/Domain Expert/Student never inferred from a paste); (c) persona_variants in agents/larry-extended.md has NO machine selector (prose-only first-touch, 4 stub fallbacks); (d) journey_stage is stored but inert (no inference engine; Phase 91 PLANNED).

syn.recommended_b1_design:
ONE persona-first B1 (reconcile ignite.md over new-project.md) with FOUR arrival doors, each resolving to {role_blend, blueprintFamily, arrival_asset}, all threaded into the EXISTING birthRoom opts contract. No new store, no new taxonomy, no new reach/edge type, no new Brain wire.

DOOR 1 - Persona pick (the default). Fire AskUserQuestion "Who are you arriving as?" with the 6 conversational personas + "Paste my CV". The pick sets role_blend from persona-taxonomy ROLE_BLEND_KEYS (import, never redefine) and DERIVES blueprintFamily: researcher/student/domain_expert -> exploration; founder-business/operator/investor -> venture (ignite.md:84-89 mapping, kept).

DOOR 2 - CV (Paste my CV / inline paste). arrival_asset=cv-upload. Run detect_dual_path -> extract_shallow (reuse verbatim). Compute a real WEIGHTED role_blend (NEW: extend blendFromCanonicalRole beyond single-axis, e.g. multiple parseRoleHints signals -> normalized tuple). Then CV-SECOND-SELECT (NEW): present extractDomains() handles as a Shape F multiSelect ("which 2-3 domains pull you?"), write the 2-3 picks, and auto-fire /mos:explore-domains (Engine 1) as the first move.

DOOR 3 - Hypothesis (NEW peer door). "Start from a hypothesis" -> capture one falsifiable "I believe ___" string (free-text). Add a `hypothesis` blueprint family to data/room-blueprints.json (arrival_asset:'hypothesis', section set = problem-definition seeded + assumptions + opportunity-bank, default_methodologies = structure-argument / challenge-assumptions / validate / research) - CI-green via check-room-blueprints.cjs, consumed by resolveBlueprint with zero code change. blueprintFamily=hypothesis; role_blend stays whatever the persona/CV leg set (hypothesis framing is auto-selected per role: researcher=testable claim / founder=market bet / investor=thesis precondition - resolve from role_blend). File the hypothesis as a truth-claim node (writeClaimNode, review_status:proposed, Part 5 tier None/Practitioner). Gate the instances-vs-structures abstraction-level control as a Shape F.x step (the highest-leverage net-new). Contract: end on a path forward / better questions, not a verdict.

DOOR 4 - Free-Text / Other (kept). Larry interprets and routes to one of the above.

WIRING (the load-bearing invariants):
- role_blend is written EXACTLY ONCE at birth via writeUserMdAtomic inside birthRoom STEP 1 (room-birth.cjs:420-433), before the confirmNode batch. The redesign computes the (now weighted) blend and passes it as opts.roleBlend - it does NOT touch the 7-step transaction or the approvedBy gate.
- blueprintFamily must resolve to a known family in room-blueprints.json or fall back to frozen SECTION_NAMES.
- Every B1 answer journals via writeScratchpadBirthAnswer and replays via drainBirthGateAnswers as typed edges (no CHOSE). WIDEN the whitelist (scratchpad-ops.cjs:217-226) to persist role_blend + blueprint_family + hypothesis_text so the signal survives across sessions (currently silently dropped).
- B3 fires only after birthRoom ok:true. Per-persona first-win resolver (role_blend x blueprintFamily -> first-framework chain) routes through Phase 122 command-resolver / Phase 166 runChain - NOT a new selection brain (Part 11 R4) - and populates ROOM.md default_methodologies FROM the chosen chain.
- All CV/domain/hypothesis handles stay Part-8 clean (auditQueryString); role_blend weights + user_id NEVER cross to Brain (only the Larry/Brain scalar via translateLarryToBrain).
- Author SPEC first (/gsd-spec-phase 174) resolving the six open questions before any hypothesis-door build; add the hypothesis family in lockstep with check-room-blueprints.cjs.

Net-new is ~15-20%: (a) weighted multi-axis blend computer; (b) optional 3-missing-axis detectors; (c) code-level persona_variants selector + filled stub copy; (d) CV-second-select multiSelect gate; (e) per-persona first-win resolver; (f) the hypothesis family + arrival branch + abstraction-level control gate + "path forward" contract; (g) widen the scratchpad whitelist; (h) reconcile the two B1 specs into one.
open_decisions: Promote Phase 174 to spec FIRST: run /gsd-spec-phase 174 to resolve the six open questions in 174-RESEARCH.md section E (single statement vs hypothesis+sub-hypotheses; how the abstraction-level instances-vs-structures control surfaces as a Shape F gate; whether hypothesis framing is auto-selected from role_blend; whether arrival auto-fires the Act 1 triple-filter or gates it; relationship to Phase 173 HEART deck H=Hypothesis pre-fill) BEFORE any build.

Does B1 need to INFER Mentor / Domain Expert / Student from a CV (build 3 new parseRoleHints detectors), or is it acceptable that those 3 axes land only via the persona pick / conversational onboarding / override? (Researcher.IND and Founder.grant are regulatory subtypes, excluded by design - not blend axes.)

Is the weighted multi-axis blend (e.g. Founder 0.6 + Researcher 0.4) in scope now, or does B1 ship with the single-axis {key:1.0} stub and defer true weighting? The Canon Appendix C definition is weighted, but no producer computes it today.

Fund the per-persona first-win JTBD resolver (role_blend x blueprintFamily -> 30-min first-framework chain, populating ROOM.md default_methodologies from the chosen chain), or keep B3 as the static Tier-0/Mode-A ranker for now? BIRTH-FLOW-BRIEF specs the per-persona chain but it is unwired.

Confirm the new `hypothesis` blueprint family's section set + default_methodologies (proposed: problem-definition seeded + assumptions + opportunity-bank; structure-argument / challenge-assumptions / validate / research). A new family is data, CI-checked by check-room-blueprints.cjs - decide whether it also warrants a Canon Appendix-D note (the seed's listed canon_parts 1/2a/3/5/10 are aspirational; a data family likely needs no frozen-set amendment).

Widen writeScratchpadBirthAnswer (scratchpad-ops.cjs:217-226) to persist role_blend + blueprint_family + hypothesis_text - confirm this is in scope, because today they are silently dropped and the B1 persona/hypothesis signal does NOT survive across sessions to B2/birthRoom.

Reconcile the two divergent B1 specs: ratify the persona-first B1 (ignite.md:80-98) as the single canonical B1 and demote new-project.md:147-188's arriving-with B1 to a pure B2 scaffold backend - confirm the navigator wants the persona-first vocabulary to win.

Does journey_stage inference enter scope (CV/hypothesis -> stage), or stay inert at the 'Ordinary World' default? Stage-aware behavior is Phase 91 PLANNED; treat as out-of-scope unless B1 explicitly funds it.

Abstraction-level control (instances vs structures) is named the highest-leverage AND highest-risk net-new piece with no existing surface - confirm it ships as a Shape F.x gate in the hypothesis door, and that a non-pharma fixture is built (domain-neutrality is a stated hard requirement; AION specifics stay quarantined in the user-local aion-eureka-synergy room, never the plugin repo).
